body.x: Magpie Tech Co., Ltd. (CEO Woong-cheol Shin), a startup that presents a new paradigm for spatial distance measurement, won the Million Dollar Top Exporter award in celebration of the 59th Trade Day.

On Trade Day every year, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy and the Korea International Trade Association award top exporters to selected export companies that have successfully pioneered overseas markets and contributed to promoting the excellence and technology of domestic capital.
Companies that were awarded were selected as export companies that successfully pioneered overseas markets and contributed to promoting the excellence of domestic capital and technological prowess.

Magpie Tech Co., Ltd. launched the world's first two-way laser distance meter "VH-80" and created an innovation with a "user-centered distance measurement" that allows you to measure distance easily by yourself.
Recently, the company has been preparing “KIKO”, a child growth management platform service that can be managed and used for easy measurement by anyone and anywhere.

The company has also won the innovation award in the digital health sector in the world's largest electronics exhibition, CES 2023, and is now preparing for a full-fledged move starting with this achievement.

From this year, Magpie Tech Co., Ltd. will enter the global market, including the US, UK, Germany, and Japan, in earnest. CEO Shin said, “We will continue to make efforts to solve customer inconveniences with good products and services, and next year we will achieve more growth as a company.”
